svg.title: Four Checks Before a Live Financing Submission
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-05-statutory-risk-preflight; chart type: decision_tree; title: Four Checks Before a Live Financing Submission; subtitle: Advance on documented fit; unresolved branches stop the affected activity.; chapter number: 5; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: These are sequential checks, not a universal licensing determination. Jurisdiction, collateral, product, compensation, and the broker's actual conduct control applicability. Numeric values identify check order rather than risk scores.; caption: Keep the legal-scope record beside the lender matrix. A lender relationship does not itself authorize brokerage activity, fee collection, or securities placement.; stages: label: Activity and licensing; value: 1 | Proceed or resolve scope; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map borrower, broker, and collateral jurisdictions. California Financial Code Section 22100 requires licensing for covered finance-lender or broker activity, subject to applicable exceptions and scope. Analyze real-estate brokerage separately. Securities activity requires analysis under 15 U.S.C. 78o(a)(1); stop that activity until the required registration path is resolved.; label: Compensation and disclosure; value: 2 | Document or revise fees; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Identify each payor, service, fee amount, earning event, and clawback trigger before engagement. For covered SBA agent services, apply 13 CFR 103.5 and required Form 159 disclosures. Assess state commercial-financing disclosure duties by role and product; revise unsupported or impermissible compensation arrangements before proceeding.; label: Fair lending and file security; value: 3 | Evidence or remediate controls; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use documented credit-fit criteria under ECOA, 15 U.S.C. 1691, and Regulation B, 12 CFR part 1002. Determine creditor status and allocate notice duties without erasing statutory responsibility. For covered institutions, implement 16 CFR part 314 safeguards; use MFA, restricted access, and documented data handling.; label: Collateral and closing exposure; value: 4 | Submit or reduce exposure; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Confirm who verifies attachment and perfection under UCC 9-203 and 9-310, including applicable exceptions. Check lender concentration, closing conditions, and commission reversal terms. Use an internal 35% single-lender retained-revenue review threshold; excess concentration triggers diversification planning, not a claimed statute.

text.title: Four Checks Before a Live Financing Submission
text.tspan: Four Checks Before a Live Financing Submission

rect.title: label: Activity and licensing; value: 1 | Proceed or resolve scope; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Map borrower, broker, and collateral jurisdictions. California Financial Code Section 22100 requires licensing for covered finance-lender or broker activity, subject to applicable exceptions and scope. Analyze real-estate brokerage separately. Securities activity requires analysis under 15 U.S.C. 78o(a)(1); stop that activity until the required registration path is resolved.

text.title: Map borrower, broker, and collateral jurisdictions. California Financial Code Section 22100 requires licensing for covered finance-lender or broker activity, subject to applicable exceptions and scope. Analyze real-estate brokerage separately. Securities activity requires analysis under 15 U.S.C. 78o(a)(1); stop that activity until the required registration path is resolved.

rect.title: label: Compensation and disclosure; value: 2 | Document or revise fees; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Identify each payor, service, fee amount, earning event, and clawback trigger before engagement. For covered SBA agent services, apply 13 CFR 103.5 and required Form 159 disclosures. Assess state commercial-financing disclosure duties by role and product; revise unsupported or impermissible compensation arrangements before proceeding.

text.title: Identify each payor, service, fee amount, earning event, and clawback trigger before engagement. For covered SBA agent services, apply 13 CFR 103.5 and required Form 159 disclosures. Assess state commercial-financing disclosure duties by role and product; revise unsupported or impermissible compensation arrangements before proceeding.

rect.title: label: Fair lending and file security; value: 3 | Evidence or remediate controls; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use documented credit-fit criteria under ECOA, 15 U.S.C. 1691, and Regulation B, 12 CFR part 1002. Determine creditor status and allocate notice duties without erasing statutory responsibility. For covered institutions, implement 16 CFR part 314 safeguards; use MFA, restricted access, and documented data handling.

text.title: Use documented credit-fit criteria under ECOA, 15 U.S.C. 1691, and Regulation B, 12 CFR part 1002. Determine creditor status and allocate notice duties without erasing statutory responsibility. For covered institutions, implement 16 CFR part 314 safeguards; use MFA, restricted access, and documented data handling.

rect.title: label: Collateral and closing exposure; value: 4 | Submit or reduce exposure; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Confirm who verifies attachment and perfection under UCC 9-203 and 9-310, including applicable exceptions. Check lender concentration, closing conditions, and commission reversal terms. Use an internal 35% single-lender retained-revenue review threshold; excess concentration triggers diversification planning, not a claimed statute.

text.title: Confirm who verifies attachment and perfection under UCC 9-203 and 9-310, including applicable exceptions. Check lender concentration, closing conditions, and commission reversal terms. Use an internal 35% single-lender retained-revenue review threshold; excess concentration triggers diversification planning, not a claimed statute.

Assumptions: These are sequential checks, not a universal licensing determination. Jurisdiction, collateral, product, compensation, and the broker's actual conduct control applicability. Numeric values identify check order rather than risk scores.
